request: Create a new BB plugin named Agent Canvas based closely on the supplied reference screenshot. Build a full-screen dark spatial canvas with draggable/resizable live thread panes using native ThreadChat, a persistent Coordinator native chat docked on the right, a compact workspace tab strip and add control, dotted background, minimap, zoom/fit/reorganize controls, and pane title/status metadata. Coordinator selection or creation must be an explicit user action through native BB controls; never autonomously spawn or message agents. Use current public Plugin SDK surfaces, preserve authorization and permission modes, persist bounded canvas layout safely, provide keyboard and narrow-screen fallbacks, add the package to the workspace catalog, install/reload it locally, and verify the visual experience against the screenshot without copying AgentGrid branding or proprietary assets.
message: Refine Agent Canvas in English and commit the completed work. In the All view, show every workspace/worktree as a clearly bounded square group with a stable distinct color, containing its live agent, child-agent, and browser nodes while preserving verified parent/ownership edges. Make the right-side Control thread truly universal for the entire Agent Canvas and allow it to operate safe UI state through explicit bounded agent tools (for example select workspace, focus a thread, fit/reorganize the canvas, or adjust zoom) delivered to the mounted canvas over the public realtime plugin channel; it must not autonomously send messages or bypass permissions. Improve navigation fluidity with cursor-centered wheel zoom, trackpad/pinch gestures where supported, smooth zoom controls, panning, and sensible reset/fit behavior. Replace polling-only status refresh with public BB lifecycle-event-driven realtime refresh while retaining a low-frequency recovery poll. Show agents and BB child-agent threads live through native ThreadChat timelines and lifecycle refresh. Show browser sessions live only to the extent supported by the public SDK: use verified automation-tab ownership and bounded periodically refreshed visual captures, clearly identifying when the preview is a capture rather than an interactive embedded browser. Preserve narrow-screen and keyboard fallbacks, authorization, bounded storage, and existing safety constraints. Add focused tests, build, install/reload, visually verify, then create an English git commit containing all Agent Canvas and Empirical feature changes without including unrelated files.
